_: The one list of bundles, read by scripts/bundle.mjs (npm run bundle), scripts/entry-firewall.mjs and src/test/entryPurity.test.ts. One CommonJS esbuild entry per module: the extension host loads CommonJS, ESM splitting is not used, and duplicate code costs disk, not start time. 'firewall' bundles are bounded by entry-firewall.mjs (allowed inputs and external imports); 'budgetBytes' is the minified size ceiling.
